scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit --run && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.db:seed:media: wrangler r2 object put quiz-game-media-local/01JSEEDASSETPNG00000000000.png --file=./seeds/fixtures/sample-image.png --content-type=image/png --local && wrangler r2 object put quiz-game-media-local/01JSEEDASSETMP300000000000.mp3 --file=./seeds/fixtures/sample-audio.mp3 --content-type=audio/mpeg --local && wrangler r2 object put quiz-game-media-local/01JSEEDASSETJPG00000000000.jpg --file=./seeds/fixtures/tokyo-station.jpg --content-type=image/jpeg --local && wrangler r2 object put quiz-game-media-local/01JSEEDASSETJPN00000000000.ogg --file=./seeds/fixtures/nihongo.ogg --content-type=audio/ogg --local
scripts.db:setup:local: pnpm run db:migrate:local && pnpm run db:seed:local && pnpm run db:seed:media
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
